source_caption:
Sebastian Stan’s performance in A Different Man works because the film isn’t just about physical transformation — it’s about what happens when someone gets the face they thought would fix their life and still can’t escape themselves. The most uncomfortable twist is that the real horror isn’t how Edward looks, but how deeply he has built his identity around being unseen.

A Different Man (2024), directed by Aaron Schimberg, starring Sebastian Stan, Renate Reinsve, Adam Pearson. A darkly funny and unsettling psychological drama about identity, insecurity, and self-perception, turning one man’s transformation into a strange and provocative study of envy and performance.

source_details.title: A Different Man
source_details.synopsis: A Different Man is a 2024 American dark comedy psychological thriller film written and directed by Aaron Schimberg, starring Sebastian Stan, Renate Reinsve, and Adam Pearson. The film follows Edward (Stan), an actor with neurofibromatosis who undergoes an experimental procedure to change his face, only for his new life to make past insecurities and new issues apparent. The film had its world premiere at the Sundance Film Festival on January 21, 2024, and was screened at the 74th Berlin International Film Festival on February 16, where Stan won the Silver Bear for Best Leading Performance.
